title: leonicenia

This plant is rich in bioactive constituents, including iridoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties. Additionally, the therapeutic actions of Leonicenia include its potential to reduce anxiety and stress, making it a sought-after natural remedy for promoting relaxation and well-being.
